verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a programmatic SDK whose documented public API is its main interface. The docs cover `act`, `extract` (with typed output shapes), `observe`, `agent`, browser launch and connect methods, and reference pages such as `BrowserClipboard`, across TypeScript, Python and Go. Community users report building on it hands-on. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/REST spec (all OpenAPI probes returned 404), and no evidence documenting the server-side API as a standalone HTTP interface.
